Risk_Description: DOM-Based Cross-Site Scripting (DOM-XSS) via unescaped search query interpolation into innerHTML sink
Evidence: User input dynamically concatenated into HTML string: resultsDiv.innerHTML = `... ${query} ...`
Mitigation_Strategy: Refactored DOM rendering to safe node creation using document.createElement and textContent. Removed all innerHTML sinks for untrusted data.
Verification_Evidence: jsdom regression suite (scripts/test-trademark-search.js) passed with 8 attack payloads and 40 assertions

Risk_Description: Misleading trademark availability and false government registry search claims
Evidence: UI claimed 'Scanning IP India public records' and 'No identical prior registrations found' without live API
Mitigation_Strategy: Removed simulated results and false availability claims. Replaced with transparent statutory disclaimer stating no official registry search was performed and added outbound link to IP India portal.
Verification_Evidence: Verified by scripts/test-trademark-search.js assertions ensuring absence of false clearance promises

Risk_Description: Statutory violation of Bar Council of India (BCI) rules and Advocates Act 1961 regarding commercial litigation services
Evidence: Pages previously presented commercial pricing cards and direct representation retainers for NCLT court litigation
Mitigation_Strategy: Removed all pricing grids and active service claims. Converted routes into informational guides with neutral independent counsel referral notices; confirmed zero claims of advocate network or panel agreements.
Verification_Evidence: Inspection of HTML source confirmed absence of commercial checkout and presence of statutory legal disclaimers

Risk_Description: Scope creep on NCLT merger page implying contentious tribunal advocacy rather than transactional secretarial support
Evidence: Title and copy implied full tribunal representation before NCLT benches
Mitigation_Strategy: Locked route strictly to transactional secretarial scheme execution under V09-SVC-003 pursuant to Sections 230-232. Excluded contentious litigation.
Verification_Evidence: Service page title and scope cards updated to 'NCLT Merger Scheme Secretarial Execution (V09-SVC-003)'

Risk_Description: Unsupported claims of live government API connectivity and real-time MCA V3 sync
Evidence: Badges and labels claimed 'Live MCA V3 Connector', 'MCA Verified', and 'Real-time sync'
Mitigation_Strategy: Replaced deceptive claims with truthful descriptions: 'Statutory Rules Engine', 'Active Profile • Rule-Calibrated', and 'Rules-Based Engine'
Verification_Evidence: Source inspection of dashboard.html, index.html, and 404.html confirms complete removal of false live connectivity claims

Risk_Description: Canonical host divergence between repository files and target subdomain (ccs.craftegon.com)
Affected_Route_Component: sitemap.xml; robots.txt; all HTML canonical tags
Evidence: Repository previously contained https://craftegon.com while Phase 1 approved target is https://ccs.craftegon.com
Mitigation_Strategy: Reconciled all 111 HTML canonical tags, Open Graph tags, JSON-LD schemas, sitemap.xml, and robots.txt strictly to https://ccs.craftegon.com. Enforced via audit-seo.js.
Residual_Risk: Low (Live DNS/TLS activation gated for Phase 2)
Verification_Evidence: scripts/audit-seo.js verifies 100% compliance: 111/111 files on https://ccs.craftegon.com; 0 invalid origins

Evidence: Approved CSV and Markdown decision register were unattached in previous session, blocking exact ID lock
Mitigation_Strategy: User provided the authoritative phase-1-service-ownership-review.csv (57 rows) and Markdown register. Reconciled all 54 approved IDs, 3 referral-only routes, and 4 coverage gaps.
Verification_Evidence: docs/phase-1-route-register.csv fully reconciled against phase-1-service-ownership-review.csv with 0 conflicts

Risk_Description: Risk of broken internal links or orphan service routes during taxonomy reconciliation
Evidence: Renaming or modifying routes could orphan pages or break navigation links

Verification_Evidence: scripts/verify-links.js (0 broken links) and scripts/check-orphans.js (0 orphan pages) passed with 0 errors

Evidence: Forms could imply automated server submission or data ingestion when no live API exists
Mitigation_Strategy: Implemented client-side field validation with explicit staged fallbacks directly to WhatsApp (+91 86069 18247) and mailto (admin@craftegon.com).

Evidence: Users could misinterpret statutory late fee estimates as binding commercial quotes
Mitigation_Strategy: Annotated calculator outputs with explicit disclaimers stating computations reflect statutory Section 403 formula and require professional CS vetting.
Verification_Evidence: Source inspection of calculator.js confirms statutory disclaimer rendering alongside estimates

Risk_Description: Premature deployment or accidental production modification during local development
Affected_Route_Component: Cloudflare Pages edge deployment; DNS; git remote

Mitigation_Strategy: Strict non-production boundary enforced: no git push, no deployment CLI execution, no DNS changes. Non-production working tree preserved.
Verification_Evidence: Git status verified: all modifications remain local in working tree
